input.title: ci: gate deploy on PR merge state
input.body: Adds a merge-state guard before deploy.

files.patch:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/deploy-guard.sh
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Deploys only after the PR is merged. jq -e exits 0 when the
+# expression is true, 1 when false — the guard branches on that.
+set -euo pipefail
+pr=$(cat)
+if jq -e '.mergedAt != null' <<<"$pr" >/dev/null; then
+  echo "deploy: PR merged — continuing"
+else
+  echo "deploy: PR still open — aborting" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi

note: Globally clean: != null is the merged test; branches consistent with the documented jq -e semantics.
